comment: Primary supplementary TableS3, sampling/assay set III, source peptide number 1; fitted pEC50=Null. Figures2-7 report peptide-dose MIP1beta responses of the named 1E6 clone with HLA-A*02:01 C1R-A2 APC. Paired literal junctions are independently reported in the named 1E6 primary deposit PDB3UTS (PMID22245737); no structure or V/J call is assigned to this functional assay. Source sampling-set labels distinguish assays, including separately measured index controls. This is a synthesized sampled decamer, not a reported natural protein fragment. Parent gene/species remain unknown; sharing a motif with the insulin index does not establish natural provenance. TableS3 reports Null and Figure4F shows a nonresponsive titration at the baseline. This tested observation is excluded from the positive build.
